استنكرت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْكَرْتُ (istankartu) /is.tan.kar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكَرْتَ (istankarta) /is.tan.kar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكَرْتِ (istankarti) /is.tan.kar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# اِسْتَنْكَرَتْ (istankarat) /is.t
